title: Structured logs
hints: slog.NewJSONHandler(w, &slog.HandlerOptions{...}) writes one JSON object per record. The Level option sets the minimum level that gets logged.
ReplaceAttr is called for every attribute. Returning an empty slog.Attr{} drops it, so drop the one whose Key is slog.TimeKey (only at the top level, where len(groups) == 0).
slog.New(handler).With("service", "api") returns a logger that adds service=api to every record.
